test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As on 31st October 2023, the youngest member of parliament (in terms of age) in the 17th Lok Sabha, Chandrani Murmu, represents which political party?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Biju Janata Dal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Chandrani Murmu is the youngest Member of Parliament (MP) in the 17th Lok Sabha, elected at the age of 25.
 
• She represents the **Biju Janata Dal (BJD)**, a regional political party based in Odisha.
 
• She was elected from the **Keonjhar constituency** in Odisha during the 2019 general elections.
 
• Chandrani Murmu is the first woman MP from Keonjhar and one of the youngest MPs in India’s parliamentary history.
 
• Her election highlighted the growing representation of young leaders in Indian politics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Biju Janata Dal (BJD):**

 
 
• BJD is a regional political party in Odisha, founded in 1997 by Naveen Patnaik.
 
• The party is named after Naveen Patnaik's father, Biju Patnaik, a prominent freedom fighter and former Chief Minister of Odisha.
 
• BJD has a strong presence in Odisha and focuses on regional development and welfare policies.
 
 
 
• **17th Lok Sabha:**
 
 
• The 17th Lok Sabha was constituted following the 2019 general elections in India.
 
• It marked a significant rise in the number of women MPs, with 78 women elected, the highest in Indian history.
 
 
 
• **Women in Indian Politics:**
 
 
• India has seen a gradual increase in women’s participation in politics, though gender representation remains uneven.
 
• Efforts like reservation for women in local governance (Panchayati Raj) have paved the way for greater involvement.
 
 
 
• **Odisha in Indian Politics:**
 
 
• Odisha has played a significant role in Indian politics, with leaders like Biju Patnaik and Naveen Patnaik shaping its political landscape.
 
• The state is known for its unique socio-political challenges, including tribal welfare and disaster management.
